prompt:
Design an expressive iOS/macOS Sunrise & Sunset widget for a desktop dashboard. Generate 5 distinct compositions in Small (160x160), Medium (340x160) and Large (340x340). One layout per size, rendered once. Never repeat a row or value.

Compositions (distinct surfaces, palettes & motion):
1 Horizon Arc Dial: Grey (#E5E5EA) shell with white 24h dial (0-22), glowing amber-indigo solar bezel arc, gliding sun orb, sweeping hand, and "11hr 20m" center badge.
2 Dusk Scrim: Full-bleed twilight sky with shifting horizon glow; white "Golden Hour" header at top; huge bright yellow countdown ("45 mins") bottom-left, white pill bar right.
3 Dual-Time Bento: White (#FFFFFF) card—top has huge "6:12 AM / 7:48 PM" + teal daylight note; bottom has 2 grey (#F2F2F7) sub-cards for solar noon and teal UV bars.
4 Solar Ring Dark: Pitch black (#111111) card with glowing neon-yellow daylight ring top-left, white header, "8h/13h · Passed" subtitle, and huge "64%" hero.
5 Terracotta Dawn: Terracotta (#E07A5F) card with glowing sun badge top-left, cream solar labels, and huge white next-event time hero.

Hard content limits per size:
Small: next sun event label, hero time/countdown, plus ONE visual (solar ring, arc, or pill bar). Max 3 items. No grid.
Medium: Small's content plus ONE block: sunrise/sunset times with day length, OR 2 grey (#F2F2F7) sub-cards.
Large: Medium's content plus ONE more block: 3 metrics (solar noon, golden hour, Δ vs yesterday) + bar chart.
Never squeeze larger content into a smaller size.

Spacing & Visual: 24px squircle; padding 16px Small, 20px Medium/Large; 8px grid, 12px+ group gaps, no clipping. One clear hero per size, other text 11-14px (never <11px). Believable data.
